name: Marco Striuli
body: Paul was responsible for a core memory of mine as being the person to take me to my first concert. I don't remember the connection, but he got us tickets to see Squirrel Nut Zippers at Rhodes on the Pawtuxet, this was probably 1998 so we were about 14 years old. I remember we were on the upper level looking down, felt like real VIPs and I thought this guy is the man! I slept over after the concert and he had to work at his dad's bakery early so I got to play Sega CD waiting for him to get done.  To him I felt it was just another day but it was one that stays with me forever. It's always one of the internet security questions in case you lose your password to prove I'm not an AI bot, "what was your first concert" and I remember him fondly.
